block_disjointness.policy: block-level: a query_idx block is the leakage unit, because the carrier re-renders the same base scenario at several tiers

candidate_pool.source: every exposure-free unit whose gold tool clears the eval floor
candidate_pool.within_roster_group_key_rationale: one unit per (tier, block): cross-tier siblings inside ONE roster are allowed, exactly as the released evaluation populations allow them (the 4,000-row ORG-1 union spans 2,059 blocks), because the property that matters is disjointness BETWEEN a construction roster and every evaluation identity. Demanding one unit per block ACROSS a whole roster is also infeasible on the post-union free pool: measured, tier7_multiturn offers 70 such candidates for a quota of 100.

design: RESERVED rung-3 evaluation roster. Unopened: no model, tool or scorer has seen these identities, and no probe-sample view of this receipt exists, so no flight can hydrate it. Registering it here makes it source (c) of the Audio2Tool exposure union, so every knowledge base built from now on reserves its blocks automatically. The knowledge receipts committed alongside this roster were built BEFORE it existed, so 404 of its 610 blocks (1,744 units) still sit inside that snapshot's construction pool; rebuild them (scripts/build_a2t_knowledge_snapshot.py, model-free, seconds) before any rung-3 read.

exposure_union.note: Union of every committed EVALUATION identity of the audio2tool carrier: probe-sample receipts, additive D1 media supplements, and roster-v1 receipts whose roster_role is 'evaluation'. Construction-role rosters are excluded by design (owner decision 2026-09-05: construction identities may be read with their gold labels, evaluation identities never can).

sample_selection_rule: one wav per (tier, query_idx) unit: the unit's lowest manifest id, which is the release's own first-successful-speaker pick
